canonical_project: Gujarat State Data Centre - Surat mini/colocation node
notes: Government state-data-centre node. Academic paper (IJCSEITR, Dec 2019) states GSDC provides mini/colocation data centre at Surat. No commercial/hyperscale project found for Surat district despite searches (DCD notes Gujarat DCs concentrated in Ahmedabad/GIFT City, outside this district). Capacity not disclosed.
